List the media, factions and combiner teams in transformerpalettes

Source: R/palettes.R
tf_media.Rd

List the media, factions and combiner teams in transformerpalettes

Usage

tf_media()

tf_factions()

tf_teams(faction = NULL)

Arguments

faction

Optional faction to restrict tf_teams() to; see tf_factions().

Value

tf_media() returns the media a palette can record, in the order "toy", "cartoon", "comic". tf_factions() returns a character vector of faction names. tf_teams() returns a character vector of combiner team names, in package order (Autobot teams first). All can be passed to the matching argument of tf_palette_names(), tf_show_palettes() and tf_find_palettes().

Examples

tf_media()
#> [1] "toy"     "cartoon" "comic"  
tf_factions()
#> [1] "Autobot"    "Decepticon"
tf_teams()
#> [1] "Aerialbots"     "Protectobots"   "Technobots"     "Constructicons"
#> [5] "Stunticons"     "Combaticons"    "Terrorcons"     "Predacons"     
#> [9] "Seacons"       
tf_teams(faction = "Decepticon")
#> [1] "Constructicons" "Stunticons"     "Combaticons"    "Terrorcons"    
#> [5] "Predacons"      "Seacons"
